name: klinik-nissa-ig-story
description: Klinik Nissa 20s Instagram Story motion infographic (HyperFrames + GSAP)

scripts.whatsapp: ffmpeg -y -i renders/klinik-nissa-ig-story-20s-4k60.mp4 -vf scale=1080:1920:flags=lanczos,fps=30,format=yuv420p -c:v libx264 -preset slow -profile:v high -level 4.1 -b:v 5600k -maxrate 8000k -bufsize 11200k -pass 1 -an -f null /dev/null && ffmpeg -y -i renders/klinik-nissa-ig-story-20s-4k60.mp4 -vf scale=1080:1920:flags=lanczos,fps=30,format=yuv420p -c:v libx264 -preset slow -profile:v high -level 4.1 -b:v 5600k -maxrate 8000k -bufsize 11200k -pass 2 -c:a aac -b:a 128k -ar 44100 -movflags +faststart renders/klinik-nissa-whatsapp-status-20s.mp4 && rm -f ffmpeg2pass-0.log*
scripts.nav:render: hyperframes render fly-to-clinic -f 30 -q high -o fly-to-clinic/renders/master.mp4 && npm run nav:encode
scripts.nav:encode: cd fly-to-clinic/renders && ffmpeg -y -i master.mp4 -c:v libx264 -preset slow -profile:v high -level 4.1 -pix_fmt yuv420p -b:v 5800k -maxrate 9000k -bufsize 11600k -pass 1 -an -f null /dev/null && ffmpeg -y -i master.mp4 -t 20 -c:v libx264 -preset slow -profile:v high -level 4.1 -pix_fmt yuv420p -b:v 5800k -maxrate 9000k -bufsize 11600k -pass 2 -af atrim=0:19.98,afade=t=out:st=19.6:d=0.38 -c:a aac -b:a 128k -ar 44100 -movflags +faststart klinik-nissa-terbang-ke-klinik-20s.mp4 && rm -f ffmpeg2pass-0.log* master.mp4
